question: A team is about to connect a shared Google Drive to Claude for the first time. Which two considerations matter most before they do it? Select two.
options: A) Whether organisational policy requires an approval before any data source is connected.
B) Whether connecting a drive turns the files it holds into Project instructions as well.
C) What the connection actually lets Claude see, so that the scope can be narrowed beforehand.
D) Whether connecting up the drive will permanently increase the size of the context window used.
E) Whether the connector removes the need to review the answers drawn from those files.
correct_answers: A) Whether organisational policy requires an approval before any data source is connected.
C) What the connection actually lets Claude see, so that the scope can be narrowed beforehand.
explanations: Correct. Most organisations require approval before a data source is connected, and that governance step precedes the technical one.
Incorrect. Connected files are a knowledge source; Project instructions are separate configuration that a person writes.
Correct. A connector is a permission-and-scope decision, so knowing and narrowing what Claude can reach comes first.
Incorrect. A connector changes what Claude can reach, not the size of the context window, which is a property of the model.
Incorrect. Material reaching Claude through a connector still needs the same scrutiny as any other source before it is relied on.
